name: B1
_comment: One parameter (lam). Stage 1 used factor 2 (0.25..8); stage 2 adds sqrt(2) steps where the PSNR changes (0.5..2.83). For lam >= ~2 (SWT) every detail coefficient is zero after one step, so PSNR is flat and an 'at grid edge' flag at lam = 8 is a tie on that plateau, broken towards the fastest run. B1.a (ISTA) and B1.e (backtracking) are solver changes and reuse B1's lam (see directions_B1.json).
